applicabilityBasis.summary: GUSD is a U.S. dollar payment stablecoin issued by Gemini Trust Company with 1:1 redemption and reserve attestations.

genius.notes: Review dated 2026-10-07: NYDFS lists Gemini Trust Company, LLC as a limited-purpose trust company and GUSD as approved/greenlisted, but that historical state standing does not establish a GENIUS PPSI or state-qualified approval. No token-specific GENIUS approval, official application or announced application pathway was located. Gemini's August 13, 2026 Form 10-Q describes possible GENIUS-related changes to GUSD operations and compliance costs, without announcing a filed application or selected GENIUS approval route. The opened March 2026 BPM reserve examination has March 23/March 31 measurement dates and an April 30 opinion; the additional May report has May 4/May 29 measurement dates and a June 29 opinion. Monthly public attestation presence is supported, without claiming the May report is the latest. enforcementStatus concerns public GENIUS-specific action: the NYDFS February 28, 2024 Gemini Earn consent order is historical non-GENIUS enforcement, not a GUSD or GENIUS issuance prohibition.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application or issuer-announced GENIUS approval route was located for Gemini Trust Company, LLC/GUSD as of 2026-10-07. The NYDFS charter and Greenlist are historical state virtual-currency evidence. The August 2026 Form 10-Q is a compliance-risk disclosure rather than a filed-application or issuer-intent announcement. No public GENIUS-specific enforcement action was located; historical Earn enforcement is separately disclosed.
